instruction: Extract the first image from the document attached in the latest email in the Notes folder and save it to /home/user/extracted_image1.png

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the first image from the Word document attached in the most recent email in Notes folder and saving it to a specific path. Verified by checking the saved image has correct dimensions (860x732 pixels) from the actual document attachment in the Thunderbird profile.
